class Tokens{constructor(){this.list=[];}
push(start,type){const last=this.list[this.list.length-1];if(last&&last.type===type)

function queryWordType(word,text,end,dialect){const up=word.toUpperCase();const isCall=text[end]==='(';if(dialect==='dcs'&&DCS_KEYWORDS[up])
return'query.keywordbsl';if(QUERY_KEYWORDS[up]&&!(isCall&&QUERY_KEYWORDS_NOT_CALL[up]))
return'query.keywordbsl';if(QUERY_EXPRESSIONS[up]||(dialect==='dcs'&&DCS_EXPRESSIONS[up])||QUERY_KEYWORDS_NOT_CALL[up])
return'query.expbsl';return'querybsl';}
function lexQuery(text,pos,tokens,embedded,dialect){const len=text.length;let afterAs=false;while(pos<len){const ch=text[pos];let m;if((m=matchAt(SPACES,text,pos))){tokens.push(pos,'querybsl');pos+=m.length;continue;}
const prevAs=afterAs;afterAs=false;if(ch==='/'&&text[pos+1]==='/'){let end=len;if(embedded){for(let i=pos;i<len;i++){if(text[i]==='"'){if(text[i+1]==='"'){i++;continue;}
end=i;break;}}}
tokens.push(pos,'query.commentbsl');pos=end;}else if(ch==='"'){if(embedded){if(text[pos+1]==='"'){let end=text.indexOf('""',pos+2);end=end<0?len:end+2;tokens.push(pos,'query.stringbsl');pos=end;}else{tokens.push(pos,'query.quotebsl');return{pos:pos+1,closed:true};}}else{let end=text.indexOf('"',pos+1);end=end<0?len:end+1;tokens.push(pos,'query.stringbsl');pos=end;}}else if(ch==='&'){m=matchAt(WORD,text,pos+1);tokens.push(pos,'query.parambsl');pos+=1+(m?m.length:0);}else if((m=matchAt(WORD,text,pos))){const end=pos+m.length;let type;if(text[pos-1]==='.')
type='querybsl';else if(prevAs)
type=text[end]==='('?'query.expbsl':'querybsl';else
type=queryWordType(m,text,end,dialect);const up=m.toUpperCase();afterAs=up==='КАК'||up==='AS';tokens.push(pos,type);pos=end;}else if((m=matchAt(NUMBER,text,pos))){tokens.push(pos,m.indexOf('.')>=0?'query.floatbsl':'query.intbsl');pos+=m.length;}else if('(){}'.indexOf(ch)>=0){tokens.push(pos,'query.bracketsbsl');pos++;}else if('=<>+-*/%;,'.indexOf(ch)>=0){tokens.push(pos,'query.operatorbsl');pos++;}else{tokens.push(pos,'querybsl');pos++;}}
return{pos:pos,closed:false};}
function continuationPrefix(text){const m=/^[ \t]*/.exec(text);const rest=text.substring(m[0].length);if(rest[0]==='|')return{kind:'bar',pos:m[0].length};if(rest.startsWith('//'))return{kind:'comment',pos:m[0].length};return null;}
function startsQuery(text,pos){const sp=matchAt(SPACES,text,pos);const w=matchAt(WORD,text,pos+(sp?sp.length:0));return!!w&&!!QUERY_START[w.toUpperCase()];}
function lexStringBody(text,pos,tokens){const len=text.length;let i=pos;if(i<len)tokens.push(i,'stringbsl');while(i<len){if(text[i]==='"'){if(text[i+1]==='"'){i+=2;continue;}
tokens.push(i,'string.quotebsl');return i+1;}
i++;}
return-1;}
function lexBsl(text,state,tokens){const len=text.length;let pos=0;if(state==='str'||state==='qstr'){const cont=continuationPrefix(text);if(!cont){state='root';}else if(cont.kind==='comment'){if(cont.pos>0)tokens.push(0,state==='qstr'?'querybsl':'stringbsl');tokens.push(cont.pos,state==='qstr'?'query.commentbsl':'commentbsl');return state;}else{tokens.push(0,state==='qstr'?'querybsl':'stringbsl');pos=cont.pos+1;if(state==='str'&&startsQuery(text,pos))
state='qstr';if(state==='qstr'){const r=lexQuery(text,pos,tokens,true,'query');if(!r.closed)return'qstr';pos=r.pos;}else{const end=lexStringBody(text,pos,tokens);if(end<0)return'str';pos=end;}
state='root';}}
while(pos<len){const ch=text[pos];let m;if((m=matchAt(SPACES,text,pos))){tokens.push(pos,'');pos+=m.length;}else if(ch==='/'&&text[pos+1]==='/'){tokens.push(pos,'commentbsl');return'root';}else if(ch==='#'&&/^[ \t]*$/.test(text.substring(0,pos))){const c=text.indexOf('//',pos);tokens.push(pos,'preprocbsl');if(c>0)tokens.push(c,'commentbsl');return'root';}else if(ch==='&'&&(m=matchAt(WORD,text,pos+1))){tokens.push(pos,'preprocbsl');pos+=1+m.length;}else if(ch==='"'){const isQuery=startsQuery(text,pos+1);tokens.push(pos,isQuery?'query.quotebsl':'string.quotebsl');pos++;if(isQuery){const r=lexQuery(text,pos,tokens,true,'query');if(!r.closed)return'qstr';pos=r.pos;}else{const end=lexStringBody(text,pos,tokens);if(end<0)return'str';pos=end;}}else if(ch==='\''){m=matchAt(DATE,text,pos);tokens.push(pos,'string.datebsl');pos+=m.length;}else if((m=matchAt(WORD,text,pos))){const afterDot=text[pos-1]==='.';tokens.push(pos,!afterDot&&BSL_KEYWORDS[m.toUpperCase()]?'keywordbsl':'identifierbsl');pos+=m.length;}else if((m=matchAt(NUMBER,text,pos))){tokens.push(pos,m.indexOf('.')>=0?'number.floatbsl':'numberbsl');pos+=m.length;}else if(ch==='('||ch===')'){tokens.push(pos,'delimiter.parenthesisbsl');pos++;}else if(ch==='['||ch===']'){tokens.push(pos,'delimiter.squarebsl');pos++;}else if((ch==='<'&&(text[pos+1]==='>'||text[pos+1]==='='))||(ch==='>'&&text[pos+1]==='=')){tokens.push(pos,'delimiterbsl');pos+=2;}else if('=<>+-*/%;,.?:'.indexOf(ch)>=0){tokens.push(pos,'delimiterbsl');pos++;}else{tokens.push(pos,'');pos++;}}
return'root';}
function initialState(languageId){return languageId==='bsl_query'||languageId==='dcs_query'?'q':'root';}
function tokenizeLine(text,state,languageId){const tokens=new Tokens();let endState;if(languageId==='bsl_query'||languageId==='dcs_query'){lexQuery(text,0,tokens,false,languageId==='dcs_query'?'dcs':'query');endState='q';}else{endState=lexBsl(text,state||'root',tokens);}
return{tokens:tokens.list,state:endState};}
function tokenize(text,languageId){const lines=String(text).split(/\r\n|\r|\n/);let state=initialState(languageId);return lines.map(line=>{const r=tokenizeLine(line,state,languageId);state=r.state;return r.tokens.map(t=>({offset:t.start,type:t.type,language:languageId}));});}
global.bslLexer={tokenizeLine:tokenizeLine,tokenize:tokenize,initialState:initialState};if(global.monaco)
global.monaco.editor.tokenize=tokenize;})(window);

(function(global){'use strict';const{Range,Selection}=global.monaco;function parseSnippet(src,variables){let out='';const placeholders=[];let i=0;function parseUntil(stop){while(i<src.length){const ch=src[i];if(stop&&ch===stop)return;if(ch==='\\'&&i+1<src.length&&'$}\\,|'.indexOf(src[i+1])>=0){out+=src[i+1];i+=2;continue;}

if((m=/^\{(\d+)\}/.exec(rest))){placeholders.push({index:+m[1],offset:out.length,length:0});i+=1+m[0].length;continue;}

if((m=/^\{([A-Z_][A-Z_0-9]*):/.exec(rest))){i+=1+m[0].length;const start=out.length;parseUntil('}');if(variables[m[1]]!==undefined&&variables[m[1]]!=='')

out+=ch;i++;}}

(function(global){'use strict';const monaco=global.monaco;const{Range}=monaco;const MAX_EDIT_DISTANCE=2000;function diffLines(a,b,ignoreTrim){const norm=ignoreTrim?(s=>s.trim()):(s=>s);const A=a.map(norm),B=b.map(norm);let start=0;while(start<A.length&&start<B.length&&A[start]===B[start])start++;let endA=A.length,endB=B.length;while(endA>start&&endB>start&&A[endA-1]===B[endB-1]){endA--;endB--;}
const x=A.slice(start,endA),y=B.slice(start,endB);const script=myers(x,y);if(!script)
return(x.length||y.length)?[{aStart:start,aEnd:endA,bStart:start,bEnd:endB}]:[];const changes=[];let ia=start,ib=start,cur=null;for(const op of script){if(op==='e'){if(cur){changes.push(cur);cur=null;}
ia++;ib++;}else{if(!cur)cur={aStart:ia,aEnd:ia,bStart:ib,bEnd:ib};if(op==='d'){ia++;cur.aEnd=ia;}else{ib++;cur.bEnd=ib;}}}
if(cur)changes.push(cur);return changes;}
function myers(a,b){const n=a.length,m=b.length,max=n+m;if(!max)return[];const offset=max+1;let v=new Int32Array(2*max+3);const trace=[];for(let d=0;d<=max;d++){if(d>MAX_EDIT_DISTANCE)return null;trace.push(v.slice(offset-d-1,offset+d+2));for(let k=-d;k<=d;k+=2){let x;if(k===-d||(k!==d&&v[offset+k-1]<v[offset+k+1]))x=v[offset+k+1];else x=v[offset+k-1]+1;let y=x-k;while(x<n&&y<m&&a[x]===b[y]){x++;y++;}
v[offset+k]=x;if(x>=n&&y>=m)return backtrack(trace,a,b,d,offset);}}
return null;}
function backtrack(trace,a,b,dEnd,offset){const ops=[];let x=a.length,y=b.length;for(let d=dEnd;d>0;d--){const vPrev=trace[d];const base=d+1;const get=k=>vPrev[base+k];const k=x-y;let prevK;if(k===-d||(k!==d&&get(k-1)<get(k+1)))prevK=k+1;else prevK=k-1;const prevX=get(prevK),prevY=prevX-prevK;while(x>prevX&&y>prevY){ops.push('e');x--;y--;}
if(x===prevX){ops.push('i');y--;}else{ops.push('d');x--;}}
while(x>0&&y>0){ops.push('e');x--;y--;}
return ops.reverse();}

class SnippetsParser{constructor(){this.setStream('');this._snippets={};}

_parse(){if(!this.atEnd()){if(this.isEquals('{'))
return this.readArray();this.errorSyntaxError('_parse:1');}

readNumber(){let num=this.charAt(this.pos);while(this.next()){if(this.isNumber()){num+=this.charAt(this.pos);}

+this._getErrorContext();this._logError(desc);throw new _StreamParserSyntaxErrorException(desc,this.pos,methodId);}

else
return null;}

continue;const stack=stacks[kw[0]];if(kw[1])

ranges.push({kind:kind,start:start,end:lineNumber});}}};const addProbe=(text)=>{if(probe.length<16)

continue;if(trimmed.startsWith('|'))

inString=false;}
let code='';while(pos<line.length){if(inString){let close=-1;let p=pos;while((p=line.indexOf('"',p))!==-1){if(line.charCodeAt(p+1)===34){p+=2;continue;}
close=p;break;}

if(close===-1)
break;inString=false;if(isQuery&&strStart<lineNumber)
ranges.push({kind:kind,start:strStart,end:lineNumber});code+=' ';pos=close+1;}
else{const q=line.indexOf('"',pos);const c=line.indexOf('//',pos);if(c!==-1&&(q===-1||c<q)){code+=line.substring(pos,c);break;}
if(q===-1){code+=line.substring(pos);break;}
code+=line.substring(pos,q)+' ';inString=true;strStart=lineNumber;probe='';isQuery=false;pos=q+1;}}
if(code)
handleCode(code,lineNumber);}

static getRangesForNestedBlock(model,regexp){let ranges=[];let match=null;const matches=Finder.findMatches(model,regexp);if(matches){let last_line=editor.getModel().getLineCount();for(let idx=0;idx<matches.length;idx++){match=matches[idx];let braces_level=0;let braces_match=false;let line=match.range.startLineNumber;while(!braces_match&&line<=last_line){let str=model.getLineContent(line)

if(braces_match){ranges.push({kind:monaco.languages.FoldingRangeKind.Region,start:match.range.startLineNumber,end:match.range.startLineNumber<line?line-1:line})}}}
return ranges;}
static getRangesForQueryBlock(model,regexp,scopes,includeStartString,includeEndString){let ranges=[];let match=null;let matches=[];if(scopes){let scope_idx=0;while(scope_idx<scopes.length){let scope=scopes[scope_idx];matches=matches.concat(Finder.findMatches(model,regexp,new monaco.Range(scope.start,1,scope.end+1,1)));scope_idx++;}}

return ranges;}

static formatCode(model){let result='';const startWords=['если','#если','для','пока','функция','процедура','попытка','if','#if','for','while','function','procedure','try'];const stopWords=['конецесли','#конецесли','конеццикла','конецфункции','конецпроцедуры','конецпопытки','endif','#endif','enddo','endfunction','endprocedure','endtry'];const complexWords=['исключение','иначе','иначеесли','#иначе','#иначеесли','except','else','elseif','#else','#elseif'];let format_range=model.getFullModelRange();const selection=editor.getSelection();const selected_text=model.getValueInRange(selection).trim();let offset=0;let strings='';if(selected_text){format_range=new monaco.Range(selection.startLineNumber,1,selection.endLineNumber,model.getLineMaxColumn(selection.endLineNumber));strings=model.getValueInRange(format_range).split('\n');let line_number=selection.startLineNumber-1;while(0<line_number&&offset==0){let str=model.getLineContent(line_number)

word_i++;}
line_number--;}}
else{strings=model.getValue().split('\n');}

offset++;if(stopWords.includes(word))
offset=Math.max(0,offset-1);if(complexWords.includes(word))
offset=Math.max(0,offset-1);word_i++;}
delta=offset-delta;let strOffset=0<delta?offset-1:offset;result=result+'\t'.repeat(strOffset)+original.trim();if(index<strings.length-1)
result+='\n';if(words.length&&complexWords.includes(words[0].toLowerCase()))
offset++;});return[{text:result,range:format_range}];}

function checkBookmarksAfterRemoveLine(contentChangeEvent){if(contentChangeEvent.changes.length&&editor.checkBookmarks){let changes=contentChangeEvent.changes[0];let range=changes.range;if(!changes.text&&range.startLineNumber!=range.endLineNumber){let line=range.startLineNumber;let prev_bookmark=editor.bookmarks.get(range.endLineNumber);if(prev_bookmark){for(l=line;l<=range.endLineNumber;l++){editor.bookmarks.delete(l);}

line_check++;}}}}

function drag(e){if(!isDragging)return;e.preventDefault();const helpButton=document.getElementById("help-button");const deltaX=e.clientX-dragStartX;const deltaY=e.clientY-dragStartY;let newX=buttonStartX+deltaX;let newY=buttonStartY+deltaY;const buttonWidth=helpButton.offsetWidth;const buttonHeight=helpButton.offsetHeight;newX=Math.max(0,Math.min(window.innerWidth-buttonWidth,newX));newY=Math.max(0,Math.min(window.innerHeight-buttonHeight,newY));helpButton.style.left=newX+"px";helpButton.style.top=newY+"px";helpButton.style.right="auto";helpButton.style.transform="none";if(Math.abs(deltaX)>5||Math.abs(deltaY)>5){helpButton.wasDragged=true;}}

    require.config({
      paths: {
        vs: './vs',
        editor: './editor'
      },
      'vs/nls': { availableLanguages: { '*': 'ru' } }
    });
    require.onError = function (err) {
      var details = err && err.requireModules ? err.requireModules.join(', ') : String(err);
      window.__consBootError(details);
    };
    require(['editor'], function () { });
  </script>

</body>

</html>
